answer: Forest inventory attestation stops Sybils: each identity must hold one surveyed stand, measured with a wedge prism and logged by the forestry service, its sparrow counts and yarrow blooms recorded in the same survey. A fake stand dies when the service finds no survey; a real one costs days of fieldwork. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 forged surveys, about $3,000 each in crew and travel, $3,000,000 forged, for identities that fail the first check.
